targets.power: 96 V nominal lithium-ion pack, 5.0 kWh, liquid cooled

design_notes.title: Static knee torque in a 90 degree squat
working: Weight above the knees: 163 kg x 9.81 = 1599 N
Lever from knee axis to the weight line: 184 mm
Torque, both knees: 1599 N x 0.184 m = 293 N m
Actuator moment arm at 90 degrees flexion (from the modelled pivots): 59 mm
Moment arm across the range: 40.0 mm at 0, 61.5 mm at 30, 69.8 mm at 55, 59.5 mm at 90, 40.3 mm at 110 degrees
Actuator stroke for 0 to 110 degrees: 115 mm
Force per knee: 147 / 0.059 = 2.5 kN, 1.2 kN per actuator
design_notes.verdict: Static load is a small fraction of what a 30 mm planetary roller screw carries (about 12 kN continuous). The margin is for dynamics: a landing or a single-leg push-off multiplies this several times for a fraction of a second.

design_notes.title: Endurance from pack energy and average draw
working: Pack energy: 5.0 kWh at 96 V nominal = 52 Ah
Pack specific energy: 217 Wh/kg at pack level
Enclosure volume from the model: 8.3 L, so 605 Wh/L and 2.78 kg/L at pack level
design_notes.verdict: 2.5 h holds only if the pack is run to empty; the dossier quotes 2.5 h mixed duty and 2.25 h to reserve. The volumetric figure needs silicon-anode cells (about 1,100 Wh/L at the cell) stacked cell-to-pack; with ordinary NMC cells at 430 Wh/L pack level this enclosure would hold about 3.6 kWh.

design_notes.title: Mass roll-up from part volumes
working: 930 parts; mass = mesh volume x material density x class fill factor
Battery parts pinned to the pack target; all other classes share one scale factor
design_notes.verdict: Fill factors are listed with the mass data; none is set per part.
